 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Revitalize your skin around the clock with Premium Skincare - Studd Muffyn Botox Day & Night Cream.

This advanced formula powered by Centella Reversa, a compound that offers comprehensive anti-aging benefits by promoting collagen production, protecting against oxidative stress, improving skin elasticity, enhancing hydration, and reducing inflammation, resulting in smoother, firmer, and more youthful-looking skin. Say goodbye to fine lines and hello to a radiant, rejuvenated complexion with Botox Day & Night Cream

 ◙ NOTE:- People with sensitive skin are advised to perform a patch test. If a rash, redness, or itching appears, stop using it.
